import argparse
import sys


def count(text, as_bytes=False):
    if as_bytes:
        return len(text.encode("utf-8")), text.count("\n") + (1 if text and not text.endswith("\n") else 0), len(text)
    lines = text.splitlines()
    line_count = len(lines) + (1 if text and not text.endswith("\n") else 0)
    word_count = sum(len(line.split()) for line in lines)
    char_count = len(text)
    return char_count, line_count, word_count


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("file", nargs="?", default=None)
    parser.add_argument("-l", action="store_true", dest="show_lines")
    parser.add_argument("-w", action="store_true", dest="show_words")
    parser.add_argument("-c", action="store_true", dest="show_chars")

    args = parser.parse_args()

    has_flags = args.show_lines or args.show_words or args.show_chars
    show_lines = args.show_lines if has_flags else True
    show_words = args.show_words if has_flags else True
    show_chars = args.show_chars if has_flags else True

    if args.file is None or args.file == "-":
        raw = sys.stdin.buffer.read().decode("utf-8", errors="surrogateescape")
    else:
        with open(args.file, "rb") as f:
            raw = f.read().decode("utf-8", errors="surrogateescape")

    char_count, line_count, word_count = count(raw, as_bytes=True)

    parts = []
    if show_chars:
        parts.append(str(char_count))
    if show_lines:
        parts.append(str(line_count))
    if show_words:
        parts.append(str(word_count))
    print(" ".join(parts))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import argparse
import sys


def count(text):
    """Return (chars, lines, words).
    Chars = bytes of UTF-8 encoded text (newlines included).
    Lines = number of newline-terminated lines; a final line without trailing
    newline still counts as one line.
    Words = whitespace-separated tokens per line.
    """
    byte_count = len(text.encode("utf-8"))
    line_count = text.count("\n")
    if text and not text.endswith("\n"):
        line_count += 1
    word_count = sum(len(line.split()) for line in text.splitlines())
    return byte_count, line_count, word_count


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("file", nargs="?", default=None)
    parser.add_argument("-l", action="store_true", dest="show_lines")
